text.description_html:
4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x Square Corners Commercial Polished Brass Hinge

Heavy duty steel polished brass door hinge with 2 ball bearings. For residential or commercial doors.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Commercial Grade)
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • US3 Polished Brass Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1/2"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually
